records.name: Capitaine Nachtrag
records.biography_en: Considers a retreat provisional until correctly dated. He rolls every revised HyperNorm map into the previous version. A dissonant card asks which corridor people actually use. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Rückzug ist lediglich ein längerer Nachtrag.

variant_notes.note_en: Considers a retreat provisional until correctly dated.

records.name: Poilu Unerschütterlich
records.biography_en: Has survived enough plans to distrust the fresh ones. He treats the HyperNorm doorway as the final defensible certainty. His cape quietly shelters a resident who disagrees. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Stellung hält. Die Erklärung schwankt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has survived enough plans to distrust the fresh ones.

records.name: Estafette Vitevite
records.biography_en: Always arrives before the destination has been agreed. She carries a route card through HyperNorm while the destinations change their names. A dissonant card offers a route home. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Eingetroffen vor Fertigstellung des Bestimmungsorts.

variant_notes.note_en: Always arrives before the destination has been agreed.

records.name: Tankiste Pointmort
records.biography_en: Knows exactly which engine noise means another meeting. Her spanner keeps the HyperNorm transport moving through contradictory maintenance orders. She keeps the loose screws as evidence. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Geräusch ist bekannt. Die Ursache ist zuständig.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows exactly which engine noise means another meeting.

records.name: Chasseur Hochhinaus
records.biography_en: Would rather climb an obstacle than explain it. His little axe finds handholds in HyperNorm walls declared perfectly smooth. A dissonant card calls the cracks useful. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Aufstieg wurde einer Stellungnahme vorgezogen.

variant_notes.note_en: Would rather climb an obstacle than explain it.

records.name: Intendant Rationnel
records.biography_en: Can divide six portions fairly among seven requisitions. He counts mess tins in HyperNorm and discovers the hungry do not divide into approved portions. A dissonant card asks for another spoon. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Rationen reichen rechnerisch. Bitte nicht nachzählen.

variant_notes.note_en: Can divide six portions fairly among seven requisitions.
